component.name: Panora
Panora
component.summary: Encrypted clipboard history with a Win+V style popup
Win+V tarzı popup ile şifreli pano geçmişi

description.p: Panora records what you copy and lets you bring it back with Super+V: text, rich text, links, files, images and colours are kept together and offered again in every format at once.

Everything stays on this machine. Payloads are encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305 using a key held in your keyring, password manager copies are never read at all, and a private mode pauses recording. Panora opens no network connections.

It talks the X11 and Wayland clipboard protocols natively (no helper processes, no polling), works on GNOME, KDE Plasma, Sway and Hyprland, and ships a GNOME Shell extension for Super+V and for GNOME releases without a clipboard protocol.
Panora kopyaladıklarınızı kaydeder ve Super+V ile geri getirir: metin, biçimli metin, bağlantı, dosya, görsel ve renkler birlikte saklanır ve tüm biçimleriyle geri sunulur.

Her şey bu makinede kalır. İçerik anahtarlığınızdaki bir anahtarla XChaCha20-Poly1305 ile şifrelenir, parola yöneticisi kopyaları hiç okunmaz ve özel mod kaydı duraklatır. Panora hiçbir ağ bağlantısı açmaz.

description.p: First public release: single-column Win+V style panel, identifiers moved to the io.github.ygkali namespace, live PRIMARY toggle, clap based CLI with man pages and completions, schema migration framework, English installer messages, packaging and CI hardening.
Native X11 and Wayland backends, GNOME bridge for GNOME 47 and older, settings, Turkish and English interface, instant paste, Zorin OS 18 readiness.
